issues.title: Sort order for showcase not validated against a real 'featured' concept
issues.description: getStyleShowcase() orders by sortOrder asc, the same field used for the full styles list elsewhere. If an admin uploads images for styles that happen to have high sortOrder values (e.g. alphabetically last), the showcase grid could look arbitrary/unbalanced rather than curated, since sortOrder was designed for the full list, not for a capped 9-tile showcase.
issues.suggested_fix: No code change required now, but note in the admin UI (e.g. help text near the image field) that sortOrder also controls showcase tile order, so the owner understands how to curate the grid.

issues.title: 9-tile cap column rule (2 vs 3 columns) is described but not deterministic
issues.description: Task 4 says 'grid columns: 2 when ≤4 styles, else 3' via 'a data-cols attribute or a modifier class — implementer's choice, keep it simple.' This is left loose enough that a test asserting column count/layout could be skipped entirely, and the DoD checklist doesn't include an explicit test for the column-count rule.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a DoD line and a test assertion (e.g. check for a `data-cols="3"` attribute or class name) so the column-count behavior is actually verified rather than just visually plausible.
